## 🌡️ MARKET ATMOSPHERE

**1. Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Market signals mixed — SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND while TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND (SPY/TLT ↑ rising) and credit proxies HYG (1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02%) BELOW TREND, LQD (1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94%) BELOW TREND are weakening credit — conflicting confirmations support a neutral label.

**2. Primary Risk Drivers?**
Credit stress rising: HYG/LQD ↓ falling (HYG 1W: -0.85% | 1M: -2.02% BELOW TREND; LQD 1W: -1.42% | 1M: -2.94% BELOW TREND). Equities vs bonds skew supportive of risk: SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND vs TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND → SPY/TLT ↑ rising. Vols easing: VXX (1W: -2.59% | 1M: -6.69%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling.

**3. Financial Conditions Signal?**
Neutral overall — Fed/rates suite reads flat but TLT (1W: -2.38% | 1M: -4.41%) BELOW TREND ↓ falling points to tighter duration-driven conditions, while SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND offsets that; dollar and yield-curve indicators are NEUTRAL per tape.

## 📈 EQUITIES & FLOWS

**4. Sector Leadership?**
Tech/semis leading narrowly: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND and SOXX (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND; Healthcare XLV (1W: +1.76% | 1M: -1.26%) in RECOVERY. Financials XLF (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -5.56%) BELOW TREND and defensives XLU (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND — style mixed / no clear leadership.

**5. US vs Global?**
US marginally stronger: SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND while EEM (1W: +1.42% | 1M: +1.21%) ABOVE TREND shows catch-up. China FXI (1W: -1.05% | 1M: -4.47%) BELOW TREND remains weak.

**6. Speculative Appetite?**
Speculation resilient but concentrated: IBIT (1W: +3.37% | 1M: +7.00%) ABOVE TREND, ETHA (1W: +1.96% | 1M: +8.90%) ABOVE TREND and ARKK (1W: +2.88% | 1M: +5.82%) ABOVE TREND, while small caps IWM (1W: -0.75% | 1M: -5.43%) BELOW TREND show narrower breadth.

## 🛢️ REAL ECONOMY

**7. Commodities Theme?**
Mixed signals and divergences: BNO (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%) CORRECTION, USO (1W: -3.57% | 1M: +16.47%) CORRECTION, CPER (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND; precious metals GLD (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND.

**8. Energy Trend?**
Energy mixed: XLE (1W: -2.96% | 1M: -0.03%) BELOW TREND while UNG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND and BNO (1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%) CORRECTION — divergence between oil and gas merits watching.

## 🧭 STRATEGY

**9. Trend Confirmation?**
CONFIRMED: Tech (XLK 1W & 1M positive) and semis (SOXX ABOVE TREND) show consistent leadership; DIVERGENCE: oil complex BNO/USO/UGA display CORRECTION patterns (1W negative vs large 1M gains) and several cyclicals/industrials are BELOW TREND — treat commodity divergence as meaningful for positioning.

**10. Portfolio Direction?**
Favor exposure to tech/semis and selective thematic risk (XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND) while reducing exposure to interest-rate sensitive and defensive names (XLU (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND, XBI (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -7.93%) BELOW TREND); monitor credit (HYG/LQD) and commodity corrections.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Sectors to Watch?**
BULLISH: XLK (1W: +3.64% | 1M: +7.47%) ABOVE TREND, SOXX (1W: +7.43% | 1M: +11.19%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: XLU (1W: -3.16% | 1M: -8.53%) BELOW TREND, XBI (1W: -1.08% | 1M: -7.93%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Commodities to Watch?**
BULLISH: UNG (1W: +6.92% | 1M: +6.92%) ABOVE TREND, CPER (1W: +0.94% | 1M: +1.37%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: GLD (1W: -1.93% | 1M: -6.62%) BELOW TREND, oil ETFs in CORRECTION (BNO 1W: -1.52% | 1M: +18.03%).

**13. Key Levels?**
VXX 20 (complacency threshold), HYG/LQD spread ~ watch 0.80 (credit health inflection), XLK/XLF 2.0 (growth vs value pivot), SPY support at recent 1W lows (monitor SPY (1W: +1.27% | 1M: +0.94%) ABOVE TREND).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. Tech and semis showing relative strength (XLK and SOXX ABOVE TREND) while credit (HYG/LQD) weakness and commodity corrections are key divergences to monitor.
